correctness.rationale: The six-variable Jacobian criterion gives g_i equal. Exhaustion by number of vanishing coordinates gives exactly twenty coordinate lines and, when every coordinate is nonzero, the 11 sign points. The Hessian restriction on e1=0 has radical exactly projective radial line at all eleven points and is nonsingular on the four-dimensional tangent quotient. The standalone checker independently validates 91 points on N(F3), 46 reduced singular points, and nonzero Hessian determinants (2,1). Finite enumeration is not substituted for the geometric-completeness proof.

value.rationale: The natural integral Barth–Nieto quintic is a classical modular Calabi–Yau model whose prime three is excluded from good-prime calculations. Its entire reduced singular support has a precise arithmetic exceptional-prime jump from ten to eleven split isolated nodes, including a new diagonal A1, while the twenty-line incidence survives. This is a complete natural singularity classification with potential use for bad-reduction and resolution study, not a routine finite-field recomputation.
